nodes.title: A style sheet writes no value

fields.context: A style sheet is a body like any other: a value written in it hides its meaning, and the sheet of the page held 355. CSS cannot import a value, but it reads a variable declared before it.
fields.consequences: Each family of measures is a decision of appearance, and the theme writes them in :root with the colours and the fonts; the page refuses a style that uses a variable it does not write. A media query cannot read a variable: the width of a narrow screen is a decision, which the page writes in the media rule around the second sheet. The lines of a grid are named, not numbered. The scale was taken as it was, so the page looks as it did; folding it is a change of decisions.

rejected.Folding the values into a lighter scale: the page would have changed at the same time as its sheet was brought into the graph
rejected.Writing the rules as syntax elements: the sheet is where the appearance is chosen; two hundred rules spread over elements would hide it
rejected.An exception for style sheets: a value without its meaning is the same problem in a sheet as in code
